2724.title: Managed worktree removal retains a local branch
2724.rootCauseOneLine: Worktree removal deletes the checkout metadata but does not delete its symbolic branch ref.
2724.proposedFix: Read the symbolic branch before removal, then delete it after successful worktree removal under the existing locks.
2724.caveats: The reproduction used the direct host-workspace path and needed no live server or provider.
